# brokerlink

> brokerlink is a free, open-source Chrome extension and local MCP server that lets Claude, Codex, Gemini and other AI tools read your own PhillipCapital MobilG brokerage account through your logged-in browser tab.

## What it does
- Exposes portfolio, cash, orders, executed trades, statements, order book depth, last trades, metrics, OHLCV and KAP news as MCP tools.
- Runs each call inside the user's own logged-in MobilG tab; the session never leaves the browser.
- Orders are disabled by default and always need a human click. Money-out endpoints are blocked.

## Install
- `pip install mcp`, `python3 server/brokerlink.py serve`, load `extension/` as an unpacked Chrome extension, log in to MobilG.
- Register `python3 server/brokerlink.py mcp` as a stdio MCP server in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, agy, OpenCode or Cursor.
